response_propositions: The letter presents the Jewish home as shaped in daily details, not only on sacred days, by Torah practice and awareness of the Divine.
It assigns the wife and mother a central role in the home's religious atmosphere, including kashrut, Shabbat candle-lighting and family purity.
It calls for broad educational activity by Jewish women and welcomes further responsible publication on these subjects.
